topic: 5. Chup-chap mehnat karo, success shor machayegi
emotion: warm, calm and quietly confident, like a heart-to-heart talk

shots.dialogue: Jo apne sapne ke liye raat ko *chup-chap* jaagta hai, uske liye ye video hai.
Har kisi ko batana zaroori nahi, bas *kaam* itna kar do ki baat khud ho.
Jab tumhari *jeet* ayegi, tab duniya sunegi. Ye video us mehnati dost ko bhejo.
